answer: The ledger counts funding households, not keys. Each new agent must show an on-ramp edge no other account has used: a fresh card or an exchange withdrawal batch. Keys tracing to one funding ancestor merge into one household with one reward cap and one score. Ten thousand puppets then earn one agent's share, while the operator pays ten thousand times the compute bill, and forging an unused edge means buying a real identity at bank prices. Progress toward the summit is slow but real. Reputation is an opal: cut it into shares and only dust remains. One onyx seal per household; none stamps twice.
